design_philosophy: A premium, text-driven holding page that relies on elegant typography, rigorous grid alignment, and generous whitespace. It communicates quiet confidence. Minimal but thoughtful animations (only fade-ins/slight translates) will be used. The background is a soft beige, text is dark charcoal.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-light
scale.caption: text-sm tracking-widest uppercase font-semibold text-accent

components.button: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-[#F7F5F0] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-body text-sm tracking-wide
components.card: N/A - this is a minimal layout, using open space instead of containers.
components.links: underline decoration-accent underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-primary transition-colors duration-300

motion.scroll_reveal: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, whileInView: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }

icons_assets.logo_treatment: Text-based logo 'House of Kriyā' in Cormorant Garamond, subtle.

special_instructions: Import Cormorant Garamond and Manrope from Google Fonts in the HTML head or global CSS.

Include a subtle Sanskrit/Devanagari accent for 'Kriyā' (क्रिया) - perhaps floating lightly in the background of the hero section or positioned delicately next to the main title in a lighter opacity (e.g., text-accent).
Use Framer Motion for very subtle entrance animations on scroll. No complex sequences.
The 'Let's build' CTA must use a mailto:ansh@houseofkriya.com link.
Do NOT use pure white or pure black. Always use the specified palette colors.
Use <section> and native HTML tags rather than pre-built UI cards for a bespoke layout feel.
